name: Fist of the Heavens, Judgement detonation
idea: Fist of the Heavens turns Spear of the Heavens into a Core spender that crashes down and splits into projectiles. Holy Light Aura's Rite of Judgement and Aegis keep Judgement on the target, Spear's Judgement Damage Bonus is a pure [x] against Judged enemies, and every Fist hit detonates and reapplies Judgement.
